column8: At the same time, a comprehensive RFID traceability system is being rolled out to ensure transparency, quality control, and process reliability. [#680](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-680)
And second question for [ Frederic ] regarding [ RFID ]. [#959](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-959)

So you saw that with traceability, we are able do many things, but we want to develop other techniques like linen recognition with AI and cameras. [#448](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-448)
And the second one, it is being able to track the customer and to track the garments. [#727](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-727)

And then the high-level system, which is the full traceability on flat linen that we have on some plants where a customer pays for, both linen invoicing, but also for the added service on the automated ordering. [#411](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-411)
Last is, of course, the traceability, again. [#482](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-482)
So we are monitoring our garments batches. [#1787](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003468571-1787)

The traceability systems in place allow the number of washes carried out to be monitored and ensure that the protective properties of the PPE are preserved, according to the standards in force in each region. [#4915](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-4915)
One of the goals is to reduce both misuse and the loss of linen that is still in good condition. [#2763](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-2763)
During their visit, the agent scans a unique QR code at the customer's premises. [#532](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-532)
